description: PK — Driving: fmr_value (composite cùng Dynamic Row Number; lấy DISTINCT theo bản nộp × dòng động)
PK — Driving: fmr_value (composite cùng Fund Management Report Submission Code); số thứ tự dòng động, mỗi dòng là 1 hợp đồng UTDM trong bản nộp
Mã quỹ nộp báo cáo (bản nộp thuộc đối tượng quỹ, loại đối tượng = 7 theo Điều kiện BA)
Mã CTQLQ quản lý quỹ nộp báo cáo — khóa lọc danh sách hợp đồng theo CTQLQ ở Nhóm 3
etl_logic: JOIN investment_fund ON investment_fund.investment_fund_id = fmr_value.investment_fund_id AND investment_fund.src_stm_code = 'FMS_FUNDS' → COALESCE(fmr_value.fmc_code, investment_fund.fmc_code)
source_entity: Fund Management Report Value / Investment Fund
source_attribute: Fund Management Report Value.Fund Management Company Code / Investment Fund.Fund Management Company Code

description: Loại đối tượng nộp báo cáo (BA: 7 = Quỹ)
etl_logic: JOIN fmr_submission ON fmr_submission.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id AND fmr_submission.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' → fmr_submission.record_tp

description: Loại kỳ báo cáo: 1=Ngày, 2=Tuần, 3=Tháng, 4=Quý, 5=Bán niên, 6=Năm, 7=Nửa tháng
etl_logic: JOIN fmr_submission ON fmr_submission.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id AND fmr_submission.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' → fmr_submission.period_tp_code

description: Giá trị kỳ báo cáo của báo cáo nộp (RPT_MEMBER): dạng chữ ('T03/2024', 'Q1/2024') hoặc số ('3', '1') — định dạng thực tế chờ dev xác nhận (O_QLQ_43)
etl_logic: JOIN fmr_submission ON fmr_submission.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id AND fmr_submission.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' → fmr_submission.period_val
JOIN fmr_submission ON fmr_submission.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id AND fmr_submission.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' → fmr_submission.rpt_year

description: Số phiên bản biểu mẫu báo cáo — chọn phiên bản mới nhất của kỳ theo cách BA xếp hạng
etl_logic: JOIN fmr_sheet ON fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND fmr_sheet.cell_id = fmr_value.cell_id AND fmr_sheet.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' JOIN fund_management_report ON fund_management_report.fmr_id = fmr_sheet.fmr_id AND fund_management_report.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_TEMP' → fund_management_report.version_nbr

description: Tên khách hàng của hợp đồng UTDM (PII — lưu nguyên văn theo ngoại lệ Data Modeler duyệt 2026-10-14, O_QLQ_33)
etl_logic: (SELECT MAX(cv.cell_val) FROM fmr_value cv WHERE cv.fmr_submission_code = fmr_value.fmr_submission_code AND cv.dynamic_row_nbr = fmr_value.dynamic_row_nbr AND cv.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND cv.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_sheet cc WHERE cc.fmr_sheet_code = cv.fmr_sheet_code AND cc.cell_id = cv.cell_id AND cc.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND cc.column_index = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_value tv WHERE tv.fmr_submission_code = cv.fmr_submission_code AND tv.dynamic_row_nbr = cv.dynamic_row_nbr AND tv.fmr_sheet_code = cv.fmr_sheet_code AND tv.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND LOWER(tv.cell_val) LIKE '%tên khách hàng%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_sheet tc WHERE tc.fmr_sheet_code = tv.fmr_sheet_code AND tc.cell_id = tv.cell_id AND tc.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND tc.column_index = 1 AND tc.row_index = cc.row_index))))
source_entity: Fund Management Report Value / Fund Management Report Sheet
source_attribute: Fund Management Report Value.Cell Value / Fund Management Report Sheet.Column Index

description: Số tài khoản lưu ký của hợp đồng UTDM (PII — số tài khoản thô, lưu nguyên văn theo ngoại lệ Data Modeler duyệt 2026-10-14, O_QLQ_33)
etl_logic: (SELECT MAX(cv.cell_val) FROM fmr_value cv WHERE cv.fmr_submission_code = fmr_value.fmr_submission_code AND cv.dynamic_row_nbr = fmr_value.dynamic_row_nbr AND cv.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND cv.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_sheet cc WHERE cc.fmr_sheet_code = cv.fmr_sheet_code AND cc.cell_id = cv.cell_id AND cc.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND cc.column_index = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_value tv WHERE tv.fmr_submission_code = cv.fmr_submission_code AND tv.dynamic_row_nbr = cv.dynamic_row_nbr AND tv.fmr_sheet_code = cv.fmr_sheet_code AND tv.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND LOWER(tv.cell_val) LIKE '%tk lưu ký%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_sheet tc WHERE tc.fmr_sheet_code = tv.fmr_sheet_code AND tc.cell_id = tv.cell_id AND tc.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND tc.column_index = 1 AND tc.row_index = cc.row_index))))
source_entity: Fund Management Report Value / Fund Management Report Sheet
source_attribute: Fund Management Report Value.Cell Value / Fund Management Report Sheet.Column Index

description: Giá trị thị trường của hợp đồng UTDM tại thời điểm báo cáo (đơn vị gốc của ô, VND)
etl_logic: (SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(CAST(cv.cell_val AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '%', '') DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)) FROM fmr_value cv WHERE cv.fmr_submission_code = fmr_value.fmr_submission_code AND cv.dynamic_row_nbr = fmr_value.dynamic_row_nbr AND cv.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND cv.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_sheet cc WHERE cc.fmr_sheet_code = cv.fmr_sheet_code AND cc.cell_id = cv.cell_id AND cc.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND cc.column_index = 5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_value tv WHERE tv.fmr_submission_code = cv.fmr_submission_code AND tv.dynamic_row_nbr = cv.dynamic_row_nbr AND tv.fmr_sheet_code = cv.fmr_sheet_code AND tv.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND tv.cell_val = '180317' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_sheet tc WHERE tc.fmr_sheet_code = tv.fmr_sheet_code AND tc.cell_id = tv.cell_id AND tc.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND tc.column_index = 2 AND tc.row_index = cc.row_index))))
source_entity: Fund Management Report Value / Fund Management Report Sheet
source_attribute: Fund Management Report Value.Cell Value / Fund Management Report Sheet.Column Index

description: Mã hệ thống nguồn dữ liệu
etl_logic: fmr_value.src_stm_code WHERE fmr_value.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_sheet s JOIN fund_management_report r ON r.fmr_id = s.fmr_id AND r.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_TEMP' WHERE s.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND s.cell_id = fmr_value.cell_id AND s.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND s.fmr_sheet_nm = '@QLDMDT' AND LOWER(r.fmr_nm) LIKE '%danh mục đầu tư%') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fmr_submission ms WHERE ms.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id AND ms.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' AND ms.record_tp = '7' AND ms.record_status_code IN ('2','3','5','10') AND ms.submitted_dt <= :etl_date)
